entities.summary: Tony F. White is an American former professional basketball player. He was a 6-foot-2-inch (188 cm), 170-pound (77 kg) point guard. He played for three teams in the National Basketball Association (NBA) before pursuing a career in Europe. Born in Charlotte, North Carolina White played for Independence High School of his hometown, before enrolling to Tennessee to play college basketball.
